description: This file is a shell script for testing Git pack-objects filtering functionalities, including object filtering based on blob:none, tree:0, blob:limit, sparse:path, and sparse:oid, among others. It contains setup procedures, test cases, and validation steps for different filtering scenarios applied to Git repositories.

methods.name: parse_verify_pack_blob_oid
methods.description: A function that extracts the first column (presumably object IDs) from input lines, used to parse verify pack output.
